title: THREAD OF LOVE
author: Monalisa Parida
text:
I was blooming
In the garden of my own world.
You came into my life
Like a gust of wind,
Seizing my emotions
With fragrance and innocence.
Our two hearts became one life;
Without each other we can`t survive.
The thread of love bound us closely.
You adorn yourself with me,
Weave me in a garland.
My heart assures:
I am yours, I am yours.
stanzas: In the garden of my own world.
